name: bold-modern
label: Bold modern
summary: Heavy display type, a saturated accent, tight rhythm. Feels energetic and current.
imagery: High contrast, tight crops, photos may be full-bleed behind short text. Duotone is not used; keep photos natural.

composition.notes: Statement hero: a few big words and one CTA. Short copy everywhere. One full-width accent CTA band per page.

name: civic-clean
label: Civic clean
summary: Neutral sans, high contrast, a deep blue accent and tidy grids. Feels trustworthy and organised.
imagery: Photos sit inside cards or alongside text, cropped to consistent ratios (3:2 or 1:1). Clean, well-lit, documentary.

composition.notes: Text-led hero with one clear CTA. Three-column feature grids. Strong section boundaries using surface bands.

name: warm-editorial
label: Warm editorial
summary: Serif headings on warm paper. Generous space, photography large. Feels considered and human.
imagery: Photos are shown large and uncropped where possible, with a soft radius. Prefer people and places over objects. Never tint or overlay photos with the accent colour.

composition.notes: Lead with a photo when the brief has a good landscape one. Feature grids at two columns. Quotes are welcome and set large.
